summary: One change in the way you have been doing things can create much more possibility than you expected it to.
body: One change in the way you have been doing things can create much more possibility than you expected it to. When Jupiter sextiles Uranus, a new idea, connection, tool, or exception can remove a limitation that had quietly been determining how far you could go. The opening may look small compared with the larger goal, but that is part of what makes it useful. Follow the option that gives you more room and see how much of the old limit was actually necessary once another route exists.
